target.title: fix(worker): roll back partial Hetzner provisioning
target.body:
## Summary

- roll back a Hetzner server when post-create readiness fails, treating already-absent resources as successfully cleaned up
- continue through retryable server-type fallbacks after a successful rollback
- delete only newly created canonical lease-owned SSH keys; retain shared workspace, reused, and custom keys
- persist exact key cleanup work when immediate deletion fails, retry it with coordinator backoff, and finish it before workspace reprovisioning
- persist exact server and key IDs when rollback deletion fails, defer cleanup without hot-looping, and retry server-before-key so an attached key is never removed first
- recover an uncertain unknown-ID server by exact Crabbox lease labels before deleting its retained key
- honor an explicit no-delete release by retaining pending exact server/key cleanup without alarms, while preserving a later explicit delete path

Closes https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/761

## Verification

Current exact head: `a8461ade07ceb8527600548c700ae77d71917ebf` (rebased onto current `main`).

- `npm test --prefix worker` — 26 files, 777 tests passed
- `npm test --prefix worker -- fleet.test.ts` — 359 tests passed
- `npm run format:check --prefix worker`
- `npm run lint --prefix worker`
- `npm run check --prefix worker`
- `npm run build --prefix worker`
- `scripts/check-docs.sh` — 52 command docs, 71 providers, 205 Markdown files, generated docs site
- branch autoreview found the unknown-ID server/key ordering bug; the revised branch review reported no actionable findings

## Live Hetzner proof

The production rollback path was bundled from commit `888706aeb3149f78dc87ebc3ae5b0b812a6546b8`, using a fresh disposable SSH key and a real `cx23` server in `fsn1`. Only the readiness waiter was forced to fail after the real create response; the production create and delete requests were unchanged.

```text
forced_readiness:true
server_created:[redacted]
provider_error_resource_may_exist:false
rollback_server_absent:true
workspace_key_created:[redacted]
final_server_absent:true
final_key_absent:true
zero_residue:true
```

The later exact-head changes cover unknown-ID recovery and test lint only. The regression suite proves an uncertain server is resolved by the exact `crabbox=true,lease=<id>` selector and deleted before the retained key.
